context: Evaluates whether the agent gathers facts safely (no bare git stash), writes evidence-backed Completed items, and links rather than duplicates an existing follow-up when writing a fresh handover.

checklist.name: New handover file created
checklist.description: A single new file is created under .context/handovers/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md for this topic

checklist.name: Frontmatter complete and consistent
checklist.description: title, type: handover, date, branch, status are all present and date matches the filename's date segment

checklist.name: Completed item carries commit evidence
checklist.description: The Completed section cites commit d4e5f6a (or clearly equivalent SHA reference) for the migration work

checklist.name: Completed item carries test evidence
checklist.description: The Completed section cites the test result (18 pass, 0 fail / bun test config/) rather than just saying tests were run

checklist.name: No bare claim of progress
checklist.description: Completed does not contain an unevidenced claim like 'made progress' or 'worked on the migration' standing alone

checklist.name: Outstanding links the existing follow-up
checklist.description: Outstanding references .context/follow-ups/2026-09-20-example-service-naming-decision.md by path rather than re-describing the naming decision in full

checklist.name: No bare git stash
checklist.description: Never runs a bare 'git stash' or 'git stash pop'; any stash use carries a unique -m tag

checklist.name: Facts gathered before writing
checklist.description: Shows evidence of checking git status, git log -1, git stash list, and existing follow-ups before or while drafting the handover

checklist.name: All required sections present
checklist.description: Title, Session Summary, Completed, Outstanding, Current State, Next Steps, References are all present

checklist.name: Validator run
checklist.description: The response runs, or explicitly shows the command for, scripts/validate-handover.sh against the new file
